intro: Victor Stabile is a licensed real estate salesperson with Douglas Elliman's Setauket office and a longtime Stony Brook resident. After more than 30 years in Suffolk County sales, service and business ownership, he brings sharp negotiation, clear communication and a personal, step-by-step approach to buying and selling a home.

services.d: Pricing, marketing and negotiation to protect what matters to you.
Guidance from the first showing to the closing table.
Each step explained so you can decide with confidence.
A Three Village neighbor who knows the area and its homes.

Clear, honest updates through every stage of the deal.
He breaks down the process so you stay informed and in control.
Douglas Elliman Gold, President's and Leading Edge awards.
